title: A declared test command run in a nested repository is silently unrecognised: the declaration preflight checks only the session's root
outcome: An agent whose declared command is ignored because its declaration isn't at the root TermAl reads is told so, instead of getting an empty check list and no explanation.
acceptance: When a command that matches a declared-command candidate runs from a cwd inside a worktree or nested repository holding a termal-tests.toml that TermAl did not read, the turn carries a host line naming the root TermAl read and the declaration it ignored, or the design records why nested recognition is admitted instead, by a test.
Recognition for the documented layout, and for repositories with no declaration, is unchanged, by the existing tests.
